scope: Prerequisite and provenance audit, not a physical validation or rendering certificate
requested_product: Vela optical camera reconstruction with a physical surface atmosphere, full-frame Reel and published source

pulsar_pic_dataset.requirement: An evolved oblique 3D pulsar PIC dataset with particle/field feedback, IDs, charges, weights, times, momenta and physical normalization

kinetic_convergence.requirement: Grid, timestep, particle number, domain, source-size and runtime convergence for the target kinetic observables

physical_optical_pairs.requirement: Physical pair energies, pitch angles and their evolution; a justified mapping from any reduced PIC scales

directional_optical_radiation.requirement: Observer-angle-dependent 400–700 nm emission, retarded arrival times and independently checked radiation normalization

optical_surface_atmosphere.requirement: Optical, angle-dependent magnetized atmosphere intensities with supported mass/radius/temperature/composition; no X-ray-table extrapolation

surface_ray_transport.requirement: Surface gravitational redshift, ray bending, occultation and consistent matching to the outer camera

vela_comparison.requirement: Separate recorded optical spectrum, normalization and pulse comparisons, identifying fitted and independently assessed data

full_frame_camera.requirement: A calculated 1080×1920 optical image sequence with a single physical pixel scale, no letterboxing, fixed recorded exposure and no schematic emitters

camera_delivery_contract.spatial_scale: One physical pixel scale shared by star and magnetosphere; crop based on calculated emission, no independent stellar enlargement
camera_delivery_contract.optical_layers: Calculated photon radiance only; no luminous field guides, species-colored tracks, artificial cones or arbitrary surface shading
camera_delivery_contract.color: CIE 1931 spectral integration; fixed recorded exposure to sRGB, then color-managed Rec.709 export
camera_delivery_contract.timeline: Must record actual simulated physical duration and slowdown; any periodic construction must be disclosed

known_atmosphere_limitation: Official NSMAXG hydrogen grids start at 0.047863 keV (~25.9 nm), outside 400–700 nm, and do not contain the required local angle-dependent optical intensity
